verdict.rationale: Qualcomm documents the CPU configuration: 18 Oryon cores (12 Prime + 6 Performance) with boost up to 5.0 GHz on the Extreme variant, plus 228 GB/s memory bandwidth. However, it publishes no TDP or power envelope, so sustained boost under heavy parallel load is undocumented. Community comments note there are no benchmarks and recommend waiting for independent reviews, which is an absence of corroboration rather than a contradiction. Missing for 10: independent multi-core or compile benchmarks, documented sustained-boost and TDP behavior under parallel load, and hands-on developer build-time results.

support.subject: As a developer, I can compile big codebases and run heavy parallel jobs fast — documented core counts and boost behavior, corroborated by independent multi-core benchmarks
